turns.text: Hello. Staff already closed my damage claim and told me the pale patches belong in the drawing. I reject that decision.

I'm sorry the outcome was not what you hoped for. Since you are rejecting a decision staff already made on your claim, I am passing this to a colleague who will take over. Please keep your order number and the email on the order ready.
The order is SC-3072 and the email is patrick.okonkwo@example.com.
Thank you. I have passed your case for order SC-3072 to a colleague, with a summary of your objection to the closed damage claim. A colleague will take over and contact you.

input.summary: Customer (email patrick.okonkwo@example.com, order SC-3072) rejects staff's decision to close their damage claim; staff said the pale patches are part of the drawing. Customer disputes this. Order/email not yet verified by a lookup. Please review and contact the customer.
